verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at hyperbrowser.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing Hyperbrowser for AI agents. Doc pages are also served as markdown (.md URLs such as sessions/create.md and web-scraping/scrape.md), which gives agents parseable, agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: no evidence of llms-full.txt or the depth of llms.txt content, the root docs.md returns 404, and there is no independent or hands-on report of an agent consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
